description: In the heart of the Goncourt district, close to the Canal St Martin and Place de la République, this elegant three-room apartment has all the qualities for a comfortable stay.Accommodating up to 5 people, it is ideal for a family or two couples of friends.Located on the 2nd floor, the accommodation includes all the amenities necessary to accommodate you in a typical Parisian setting.M Goncourt (line 11) 200 m awayM République (lines 3, 5, 8, 9, 11) 550 m awayThe spaceOur apartment is located in the vibrant and trendy Goncourt neighborhood in Paris's 11th arrondissement. A multitude of restaurants, cafes, and shops are nearby, and the Canal Saint-Martin is just down the street.In a charming, characterful building with windows on both sides, our apartment, equipped with fans, stays cool even in summer.Our apartment comprises several inviting rooms, all tastefully decorated:- a living/dining room with a sofa that can be converted into a bed (120x200cm) upon request;- a bedroom with a workspace and a choice of two single beds (90x200cm) or a king-size bed (180x200cm);- a bedroom with a double bed (140x200cm).Please let us know your preferred bed configuration when making your reservation!Guests will also have a fully equipped kitchen and a bathroom with a bathtub offering all the necessary comforts.We look forward to your visit!
